title: Unit Converter — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Converts scientific and everyday measurements accurately. The Unit Converter converts scientific and everyday measurements. It handles length, mass, volume, temperature, pressure, energy, and more, showing the conversion factor used and the full calculation. Compound units like miles per hour to meters per second are converted step by step, and the result is checked by converting back.
